##### Project general facts

Binghatti Elite is a contemporary residential development, designed to combine modern architecture with practical urban living. As one of the developer’s first projects in this area, it introduces a fresh architectural identity defined by sleek lines, dynamic forms, and efficient design. The project offers a selection of studios and one-bedroom apartments, all thoughtfully planned with functional layouts, natural light, and a focus on comfort and everyday convenience.

Residents benefit from a range of amenities designed to enhance both lifestyle and daily living. The development provides a modern residential environment supported by convenient access to key business hubs, retail outlets, and essential services. Its strategic location ensures connectivity across Dubai, while the overall concept promotes a balanced lifestyle that combines accessibility, комфорт, and contemporary urban living.

Interiors are finished with modern, high-quality materials, ensuring durability and a clean, refined aesthetic. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, providing immediate functionality and convenience for residents. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while benefiting from well-designed layouts and a strong architectural foundation that supports both end-use and investment potential.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City, formerly known as International Media Production Zone (IMPZ), is a vibrant and specialized community located in Dubai. It is designed to cater to the needs of the media production industry, offering a range of services, facilities, and infrastructure to support the production of print, publishing, and media content.

The community of Dubai Production City is designed to foster creativity, collaboration, and innovation. It offers a range of amenities and services to support the needs of professionals, including commercial spaces, offices, and retail outlets. The community also hosts events, workshops, and networking opportunities that encourage knowledge sharing, skill development, and growth.

Dubai Production City is well-connected to other key areas of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and public transportation networks. Its strategic location ensures convenient connectivity to business districts, residential areas, and cultural landmarks, making it an attractive destination for professionals and residents alike.
